Contributor.Organization: Walter and Eliza Hall Institute of Medical Research

Sample.Title: Luminal virgin #1

Channel.Growth-Protocol: Luminal and basal cells were sorted directly from mouse mammary glands.
Channel.Extract-Protocol: FACS-sorted cells were lysed for RNA preparation using the QIAGEN RNeasy Plus Mini-kit. RNA libraries were prepared for sequencing using standard Illumina protocols.

Sample.Description: Sample name: MCL1-LA MCL1-LA_BC2CTUACXX_GATCAG_L001_R1 Raw data file batch date: Aug. 9, 2013
Sample.Data-Processing: Illumina CASAVA pipeline version 1.8.2 used for basecalling. Reads were aligned to the mouse genome by subread version 1.4.4. Read counts were summarized by Entrez Gene ID using the Rsubread featureCounts function and NCBI annotation. Genome_build: GRCm38 (mm10, NCBI build 38.1) Supplementary_files_format_and_content: Tab-delimited text files were written from the R prompt; columns represent Entrez Gene ID, total gene length (total base count of all exons) and the number of reads mapping to that gene.

Series.Title: Transcriptome analysis of luminal and basal cell subpopulations in the lactating versus pregnant mammary gland
Series.Summary: To identify genes specifically expressed in lactating mammary glands, the gene expression profiles of luminal and basal cells from different developmental stages were compared.
Series.Overall-Design: Comparison of gene expression in luminal and basal cells harvested from the mammary glands of virgin, 18.5 day pregnant and 2 day lactating mice (2 mice per stage).
Series.Type: Expression profiling by high throughput sequencing
